legacy_placeholder_findings.assessment: All six repeat an existing named/numbered placeholder for Chinese phrasing. No source placeholder is lost and no new index is introduced. Kept as inherited count-parity findings, not a clean full-scan claim.

legacy_typography_findings.assessment: Reviewed existing ASCII quotes, dot sequences, musical/ellipsis-only lines and legacy untranslated notes/voices. Preserved under the existing-translation scope; not reclassified as newly introduced.

other_legacy_findings: Legacy keyword spacing, Korean strings and rich-text findings are retained with exact paths. Identical source and target baseline fields are not evidence that every legacy issue is harmless. Full legacy semantic/runtime review is outside this delivery.

rules_calibration.metadata: Engine identity/model fields, explicit source comments, speech trigger desc and source-directed name-only item desc are excluded; actual visible name/nickName/dlg are checked.
rules_calibration.keyword_spacing: Only ASCII encoded references are checked automatically; Chinese headings, prose and compounds are not assumed to be tooltip IDs. Source keyword IDs must still be retained in changed fields.
rules_calibration.source_lookup: Relative directories and KR_ prefixes are resolved for full, subdirectory and single-file scans. Invalid or unreadable source fails explicitly.
rules_calibration.rich_text: New findings still block. Legacy color/size scopes are not automatically fixed from XML nesting assumptions.
